releaseNotesKm: ម៉ោងទំនេររបស់អ្នកមានប្រសិទ្ធភាពហើយ។ ទិដ្ឋភាពថ្ងៃបង្ហាញព្រឹត្តិការណ៍គ្រប់ម៉ោង។ ជួសជុលការនាំចូល .ics និងការជូនដំណឹង។
releaseNotesEn: Fixes free-time suggestions that ignored your availability hours and offered hours already past, a day view that hid events outside 06:00-22:00, an event that clashed with itself, .ics import that shifted times across zones and dropped reminders, and colour pickers that a screen reader could not use. Arming reminders can no longer crash the app.
